title: A clue across sites

doesNotKnow: The same marked fossil occurs in one layer at each modeled site. Under the stated short-lived, widespread assumption it helps correlate layers; additional evidence is needed to determine an absolute age.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: Two modeled rock sequences contain the same short-lived, widespread fossil type. What can that shared fossil help scientists do?
